evidence.scope: Annual 2026 inference for this exact server and current-tick API only. Half-open intervals are encoded server wall time, not UTC. No permanent DST recurrence or historical-API conversion is claimed.
evidence.basis: FTMO's standing specification says MetaTrader is GMT+2 plus DST; dated 2026 notices establish the March US-aligned change and the October GMT+3 period, with normal schedules restored on 2 November. The exact 2026 autumn instant is not established, so the entire 1 November server day is excluded. Winter offsets outside the cited current period are annual-policy inference.
evidence.liveFieldVerification: Three FTMO-Demo samples on 2026-10-21 with Python SDK 5.0.6231 and terminal build 6230 showed current-tick raw server wall time about three hours ahead of independently checked UTC. Example raw time_msc=1792585999508 versus host capture range 1792575202219..1792575204240. This establishes the field domain for the sampled route, not quote freshness.
